Celebrations in Smoke#402.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#403.src: It was a gamble to avoid mentioning my desertion. I had to weigh the odds of you finding evidence of my desertion with the danger I might be in by admitting to it.
Celebrations in Smoke#403.dst: Firarımdan bahsetmemek bir kumardı. Firarıma dair kanıt bulma ihtimalini, bunu itiraf edersem düşebileceğim tehlikeyle tartmam gerekti.
Celebrations in Smoke#403.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#404.src: With hindsight, I bet wrongly, but I don't think my bet was irrational.
Celebrations in Smoke#404.dst: Geriye dönüp bakınca yanlış oynadım ama oynadığım kumarın mantıksız olduğunu düşünmüyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#404.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#405.src: Had you been a worse investigator or gotten a bit less lucky, it would have paid off immensely.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.dst: Daha kötü bir müfettiş olsaydın ya da biraz daha az şanslı olsaydın, fazlasıyla karşılığını alacaktı.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#406.src: And I trust that even now, you are a fair enough judicator you will look at the facts and only the facts.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.dst: Ve şimdi bile, sadece gerçeklere ve yalnızca gerçeklere bakacak kadar adil bir yargıç olduğuna güveniyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#407.src: The facts that show I had nothing to do with what you're investigating.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.dst: Araştırdığın şeyle hiçbir ilgim olmadığını gösteren gerçeklere.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#408.src: You could. And if you did you would be personally and entirely responsible for my death.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.dst: Yapabilirsin. Ve yaparsan ölümümden bizzat ve tamamen sen sorumlu olursun.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#409.src: Should you choose to, I hope my face haunts your nightmares for the rest of your life.
Celebrations in Smoke#409.dst: Bunu seçersen umarım yüzüm hayatının sonuna kadar kâbuslarına girer.
Celebrations in Smoke#409.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#410.src: But I don't think you will.
Celebrations in Smoke#410.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#411.src: I'll admit I struggle to express this in words, but you don't seem the type.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.dst: Bunu kelimelere dökmekte zorlandığımı itiraf ediyorum ama sen o tip birine benzemiyorsun.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#412.src: You couldn't really go through with something like that.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.dst: Öyle bir şeyi gerçekten sonuna kadar götüremezdin.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#414.src: Military life was too stifling for me. So many direct orders that I can do nothing but obey.
Celebrations in Smoke#414.dst: Askerlik hayatı benim için fazla boğucuydu. Körü körüne itaat etmekten başka bir şey yapamadığım o kadar çok doğrudan emir vardı ki.
Celebrations in Smoke#414.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#415.src: And it was so boring. Most of my time was spent standing still, watching for threats that never came.
Celebrations in Smoke#415.dst: Hem çok sıkıcıydı. Zamanımın çoğu kıpırdamadan durup hiç gelmeyen tehditleri gözlemekle geçti.
Celebrations in Smoke#415.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#416.src: So I left. I wish them all the best and apologize to Her Majesty for my inability to serve her as I wanted to, but my time soured me on the whole affair.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.dst: Ben de ayrıldım. Hepsine en iyisini diliyorum ve Majesteleri'ne istediğim gibi hizmet edemediğim için özür dilerim, ama geçirdiğim zaman bütün bu işten soğumama yol açtı.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#417.src: Oh, I see you're getting better at this.
Celebrations in Smoke#417.dst: Ah, bu işte daha iyi olmaya başladığını görüyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#417.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#418.src: Yes, the other reason I left was the brutality of it. I do not handle blood well and was unprepared for the amount of blood I would see.
Celebrations in Smoke#418.dst: Evet, ayrılmamın diğer sebebi de bu işin vahşetiydi. Kana pek dayanamam ve göreceğim kan miktarına hazırlıklı değildim.
Celebrations in Smoke#418.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#419.src: Most of the time, being a soldier is dull. Mind numbingly so. But the few times it was not made me wish more than anything in the world that I could be bored.
Celebrations in Smoke#419.dst: Asker olmak çoğu zaman sıkıcıdır. Akıl uyuşturacak kadar hem de. Ama sıkıcı olmadığı o birkaç sefer, dünyada her şeyden çok sıkılmayı dilememe yol açtı.
Celebrations in Smoke#419.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#420.src: I'm not even sure the violence was wrong, I just cannot participate in it.
Celebrations in Smoke#420.dst: Şiddetin yanlış olduğundan bile emin değilim, sadece onun bir parçası olamıyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#420.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#421.src: Unpleasant life at home. There was nothing for me to stay behind for. The military seemed like my best way out.
Celebrations in Smoke#421.dst: Evdeki hayatım tatsızdı. Orada kalmam için hiçbir sebep yoktu. Ordu en iyi kaçış yolum gibi görünüyordu.
Celebrations in Smoke#421.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#422.src: I think I would make the same choice again, even knowing how it would end. There's no way I could stay there for much longer.
Celebrations in Smoke#422.dst: Sanırım nasıl biteceğini bilsem bile aynı seçimi yine yapardım. Orada daha uzun süre kalmamın hiçbir yolu yoktu.
Celebrations in Smoke#422.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#424.src: Let me look at that more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#424.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#425.src: No, I don't. The residue smells far more pungent than any drink I recognize.
Celebrations in Smoke#425.dst: Hayır, tanımıyorum. Kalıntı, bildiğim her içecekten çok daha keskin kokuyor.
Celebrations in Smoke#425.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#426.src: If you found it here, you could try asking around the festival to see if anyone else recognizes it.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.dst: Burada bulduysan festivalde başka tanıyan var mı diye etrafa sorabilirsin.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#428.src: Well, I can tell you it's not definitely not green tea. Not sure beyond that.
Celebrations in Smoke#428.dst: Şunu söyleyebilirim, kesinlikle yeşil çay değil. Ötesinden emin değilim.
Celebrations in Smoke#428.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#429.src: Hmm... neither of us have seen anyone carrying something that smells like that in.
Celebrations in Smoke#429.dst: Hmm... ikimiz de böyle kokan bir şeyi içeri taşıyan kimseyi görmedik.
Celebrations in Smoke#429.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#430.src: It would have had to have already been in {p} or they would have had to have arrived even before us.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.dst: Ya zaten {p} içinde olmalıydı ya da getirenler bizden bile önce gelmiş olmalı.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#431.src: A broken bottle? It looks kind of like the ones we use for our Bottles of Mist, but the smell is totally different.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.dst: Kırık bir şişe mi? Bottles of Mist için kullandığımız şişelere benziyor ama kokusu bambaşka.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#432.src: Whoa, that's super cool! I bet those pointy edges could hurt a changeling pretty bad...
Celebrations in Smoke#432.dst: Vay, bu süper havalı! Bahse girerim o sivri kenarlar bir değişkini fena yaralar...
Celebrations in Smoke#432.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#433.src: Recognize it? No, but I wish I did!
Celebrations in Smoke#433.dst: Tanıyor muyum? Hayır, ama keşke tanısaydım!
Celebrations in Smoke#433.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#434.src: That smell... I don't recognize it, I'm afraid. It certainly doesn't smell safe!
Celebrations in Smoke#434.dst: Bu koku... Korkarım tanımıyorum. Ama hiç de güvenli kokmuyor!
Celebrations in Smoke#434.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#435.src: I don't recognize it. Would you mind putting it away though? The smell appears to be bothering a couple of the foxes.
Celebrations in Smoke#435.dst: Tanımıyorum. Ama onu kaldırabilir misin? Koku birkaç tilkiyi rahatsız ediyor gibi.
Celebrations in Smoke#435.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#437.src: It's vaguely familiar to me, but I'm sorry to say I can't place where from.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.dst: Bana belli belirsiz tanıdık geliyor ama ne yazık ki nereden olduğunu çıkaramıyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#438.src: Whatever it is though, I certainly didn't bring it here.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.dst: Ne olursa olsun, buraya ben getirmedim, orası kesin.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#439.src: aUm, no, I don't think so.
Celebrations in Smoke#439.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#440.src: Sorry if you were hoping I had.
Celebrations in Smoke#440.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#443.src: There's not much distinctive about it though, except for that odor.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.dst: Gerçi o koku dışında pek ayırt edici bir yanı yok.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#444.src: No. And we're in the middle of a conversation, please don't interrupt us.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.dst: Hayır. Hem şu an sohbetin ortasındayız, lütfen lafımızı bölme.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#445.src: That bottle? Absolutely not, that smell is much more than what this old body could take.
Celebrations in Smoke#445.dst: O şişe mi? Kesinlikle hayır, o koku bu yaşlı bedenin kaldırabileceğinden çok fazla.
Celebrations in Smoke#445.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#447.src: But they paid me pretty good not to say!
Celebrations in Smoke#447.dst: Ama söylemeyeyim diye bana epey iyi para verdiler!
Celebrations in Smoke#447.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#448.src: The only way I would is if I were to really be impressed by someone.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.dst: Söylemem için birinin beni gerçekten etkilemesi lazım.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#450.src: Ha! I knew you couldn't do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#450.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#451.src: No hard feelings, nobody can expect to beat me at fox racing though.
Celebrations in Smoke#451.dst: Alınma ama kimse beni tilki yarışında yenmeyi bekleyemez.
Celebrations in Smoke#451.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#452.src: Of course, if you want to try again, you're free to. Just don't be surprised when you get the same result.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.dst: Tabii yeniden denemek istersen denemekte özgürsün. Sadece aynı sonucu alınca şaşırma.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#454.src: You won!? I-I-I've never been beaten!
Celebrations in Smoke#454.dst: Kazandın mı!? B-b-beni hiç kimse yenmemişti!
Celebrations in Smoke#454.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#455.src: I don't even know how that's possible, you looked like you were just picking randomly!
Celebrations in Smoke#455.dst: Bunun nasıl mümkün olduğunu bile bilmiyorum, rastgele seçiyormuş gibi görünüyordun!
Celebrations in Smoke#455.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#456.src: Well, fair is fair. You gave me a good show, I'll tell you what I know.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.dst: Peki, hak hakkı. Bana iyi bir gösteri sundun, bildiğimi anlatacağım.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#457.src: It's really not that big of a deal, I'm not sure why they paid me to stay quiet about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.dst: Aslında o kadar da büyük bir mesele değil, bu konuda susmam için bana neden para verdiklerini anlamadım.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#458.src: While studying the foxes before the races started, I caught some members of the Kalkalrah clan bringing in bottles like those.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.dst: Yarışlar başlamadan önce tilkileri incelerken, Kalkalrah klanından bazılarını bunlara benzer şişeleri içeri sokarken gördüm.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#459.src: I thought they were just green tea, but clearly they're not!
Celebrations in Smoke#459.dst: Yeşil çay sanmıştım ama belli ki değillermiş!
Celebrations in Smoke#459.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#460.src: I'm not positive where they are now, but I think I saw them head up the zipline to the second floor of {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#460.dst: Şu an nerede olduklarından emin değilim ama sanırım teleferikle {p} içinde ikinci kata çıktıklarını gördüm?
Celebrations in Smoke#460.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#461.src: And if you'd teach me your racing technique at some point, I'd really appreciate it!
Celebrations in Smoke#461.dst: Bir ara bana yarış tekniğini öğretirsen çok sevinirim!
Celebrations in Smoke#461.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#462.src: Be careful with the accusations you throw around.
Celebrations in Smoke#462.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#463.src: Not everyone has their guard down around this festival for those who stick their noses where they don't belong.
Celebrations in Smoke#463.dst: Bu festivalde burnunu ait olmadığı yerlere sokanlara karşı herkes gardını indirmiş değil.
Celebrations in Smoke#463.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#464.src: Give me that, let me look at what you were showing them more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.dst: Ver şunu, onlara gösterdiğin şeye bir de yakından bakayım.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#465.src: Ahhh, yes, you know something about that group, don't you?
Celebrations in Smoke#465.dst: Ahhh, evet, o grup hakkında bir şeyler biliyorsun, değil mi?
Celebrations in Smoke#465.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#466.src: You don't need to tell me, I know as much as you do and more.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.dst: Söylemene gerek yok, ben de senin kadar, hatta daha fazlasını biliyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#467.src: It's been many years since I was able to freely move about the city, my old age imprisoning me in my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#467.dst: Şehirde özgürce dolaşabildiğim günlerin üzerinden çok yıl geçti, yaşlılık beni evime hapsetti.
Celebrations in Smoke#467.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#468.src: But I can still sit and watch the scurrying people below. I can see what they all do when they think nobody is watching.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.dst: Ama hâlâ oturup aşağıda koşturan insanları izleyebiliyorum. Kimse bakmıyor sandıklarında ne yaptıklarını görebiliyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#469.src: It's a sort of power. A way to keep myself grounded, hanging here in the canopy.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.dst: Bir çeşit güç bu. Burada, ağaçların tepesinde asılı dururken ayaklarımı yere bastırmanın bir yolu.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#470.src: I watched you scramble to extinguish the fire and I watched what that group did after the flame was lit.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.dst: Yangını söndürmek için nasıl koşturduğunu da izledim, alev yandıktan sonra o grubun ne yaptığını da.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#471.src: I watched as those three outsiders were corralled into custody.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.dst: O üç yabancının nasıl toplanıp gözaltına alındığını izledim.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#472.src: However, I cannot hear the details. I do not know the specifics.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.dst: Ama ayrıntıları duyamıyorum. İnce ayrıntıları bilmiyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#473.src: Tell me what your suspects have done and what you have found. Then, I will give you what you seek.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.dst: Şüphelilerinin ne yaptığını ve neler bulduğunu anlat bana. Sonra da aradığını vereceğim.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#474.src: A bunch of lying outsiders then. To be expected, it's a pity you can't say they all did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.dst: Bir sürü yalancı yabancı demek. Beklenen bir şey; hepsinin yaptığını söyleyememen ne yazık.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#475.src: As for that clique, I suspect they're secretly security for the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.dst: O hizbe gelince, gizlice festivalin güvenliğini sağladıklarından şüpheleniyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#476.src: I didn't see who lit the flame, but moments after it was lit, one of them threw a bottle just like the one you're holding at it.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.dst: Alevi kimin yaktığını görmedim ama yandıktan birkaç saniye sonra içlerinden biri elindekinin aynısı bir şişeyi ateşe fırlattı.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#477.src: It must have been filled with fuel, because after it hit the flame grew much larger.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.dst: İçi yakıtla dolu olmalı, çünkü çarptıktan sonra alev çok daha büyüdü.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#478.src: Probably for the best, you never know what vermin you can roast if you're not afraid to burn the bush.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.dst: Muhtemelen en iyisi buydu; çalıyı yakmaktan korkmazsan kimbilir ne haşaratı kızartabilirsin.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#479.src: If you will entertain an old woman, then I have no use for you. Quit blocking my view.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.dst: Yaşlı bir kadını eğlendirmeyeceksen sana ihtiyacım yok. Manzaramı kapatmayı bırak.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#480.src: My investigator has returned. Now, tell me what you know.
Celebrations in Smoke#480.dst: Müfettişim geri döndü. Hadi, bildiklerini anlat bana.
Celebrations in Smoke#480.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#481.src: You look like you have something on your mind, what is it?
Celebrations in Smoke#481.dst: Kafanda bir şey var gibi görünüyorsun, nedir?
Celebrations in Smoke#481.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#482.src: Ah, I see your investigations have borne fruit.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.dst: Ah, görüyorum ki soruşturman meyvesini vermiş.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#483.src: Yes. As you have seen, people tend to let their guard down at the festival in a way they normally wouldn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#483.dst: Evet. Gördüğün gibi insanlar festivalde normalde yapmayacakları şekilde gardlarını indirme eğiliminde.
Celebrations in Smoke#483.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#484.src: They are a necessity to ensure any unexpected guests are swiftly taken care of.
Celebrations in Smoke#484.dst: Beklenmedik misafirlerin hızla icabına bakılması için onlar bir zorunluluk.
Celebrations in Smoke#484.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#485.src: I suspect you're probably right. And yet, that is irrelevant.
Celebrations in Smoke#485.dst: Muhtemelen haklısın. Yine de bunun bir önemi yok.
Celebrations in Smoke#485.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#486.src: You will tell me they are reckless and a danger to others. I don't disagree, but I encourage you to look at the wider picture.
Celebrations in Smoke#486.dst: Bana onların pervasız ve başkaları için tehlikeli olduğunu söyleyeceksin. Karşı çıkmıyorum ama büyük resme bakmanı tavsiye ederim.
Celebrations in Smoke#486.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#487.src: If we let up our vigilance for even a moment, we have already lost our war. Our clans and families will be infiltrated within the day.
Celebrations in Smoke#487.dst: Bir an bile dikkatimizi gevşetirsek savaşımızı çoktan kaybetmişiz demektir. Klanlarımıza ve ailelerimize daha gün bitmeden sızılır.
Celebrations in Smoke#487.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#488.src: Their recklessness prevents this. In a case where the smallest failure would be a catastrophe, recklessness becomes necessity.
Celebrations in Smoke#488.dst: Onların pervasızlığı bunu önlüyor. En küçük hatanın felaket olacağı bir durumda pervasızlık zorunluluğa dönüşür.
Celebrations in Smoke#488.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#489.src: Imagine they had not acted rashly in throwing the bottle of fuel onto the already lit flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#489.dst: Zaten yanan aleve yakıt şişesini atarken aceleci davranmadıklarını bir düşün.
Celebrations in Smoke#489.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#490.src: They did not create the flame, someone else must have been hoping to gain from it.
Celebrations in Smoke#490.dst: Alevi onlar yakmadı, başka biri ondan bir çıkar ummuş olmalı.
Celebrations in Smoke#490.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#491.src: Their actions, while dangerous, prevented any fiends from exploiting the opportunity. We took it out of their control.
Celebrations in Smoke#491.dst: Yaptıkları tehlikeli olsa da hiçbir şeytanın bu fırsattan yararlanmasına izin vermedi. Kontrolü onların elinden aldık.
Celebrations in Smoke#491.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#492.src: Whatever risk their actions created was worth the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#492.dst: Yaptıklarının yarattığı risk, ödenen bedele değdi.
Celebrations in Smoke#492.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#493.src: Apologies for rambling, I assure you though that safety is our top concern. Whatever the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#493.dst: Lafı uzattığım için kusura bakma ama sana temin ederim ki en büyük önceliğimiz güvenlik. Bedeli ne olursa olsun.
Celebrations in Smoke#493.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#494.src: Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or look into the suspects a bit more.
Celebrations in Smoke#494.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki festival düzenleyicisine dön ya da şüphelileri biraz daha araştır.

Celebrations in Smoke#495.src: You think you know who the changeling is?
Celebrations in Smoke#495.dst: Değişkinin kim olduğunu bildiğini mi düşünüyorsun?
Celebrations in Smoke#495.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#496.src: You've dug into them all and have found something? Excellent.
Celebrations in Smoke#496.dst: Hepsini araştırıp bir şey mi buldun? Harika.
Celebrations in Smoke#496.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#497.src: So, who do you think tried to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#497.dst: Peki, sence hasır adamı yakmaya çalışan kim?
Celebrations in Smoke#497.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#498.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#498.dst: {~} numaralı şüpheli mi? Pekâlâ. Bundan sonrasını ben hallederim.
Celebrations in Smoke#498.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#499.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#499.dst: Yardımın için tekrar çok teşekkürler. Bu konuda bize yardım etmenin festivalin başarılı geçmesini ne kadar sağladığını yeterince vurgulayamam.
Celebrations in Smoke#499.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#500.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#500.dst: Festivalin geri kalanının tadını çıkar ve hasır adamın yanışını izlemeyi unutma! Minnettarlığımızın bir göstergesi olarak sana önde özel bir yer ayıracağım.
Celebrations in Smoke#500.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#507.src: I understand your reticense to pick one. We don't have anything close to the information required to make a proper judgement.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.dst: Birini seçmekte çekingen davranmanı anlıyorum. Doğru bir karar vermek için gereken bilginin yakınından bile geçmiyoruz.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#508.src: But you cannot allow that to stop you. We do not have the luxury to close our eyes and pretend it didn't happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.dst: Ama bunun seni durdurmasına izin veremezsin. Gözlerimizi kapatıp hiçbir şey olmamış gibi davranma lüksümüz yok.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#509.src: Please, from the inevitably incomplete investigation you conducted, tell me who you think lit that flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#509.dst: Lütfen, yürüttüğün kaçınılmaz olarak eksik soruşturmaya dayanarak o alevi kimin yaktığını düşündüğünü söyle bana.
Celebrations in Smoke#509.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#510.src: Very well then. I am disappointed, but understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#510.dst: Pekâlâ o zaman. Hayal kırıklığına uğradım ama anlıyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#510.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#511.src: I will take care of things from this point forward.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#512.src: In thanks for saving the wickerman, there will be a seat saved for you when you are ready to watch it burn.
Celebrations in Smoke#512.dst: Hasır adamı kurtardığın için teşekkür olarak, yanışını izlemeye hazır olduğunda sana bir yer ayrılmış olacak.
Celebrations in Smoke#512.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#513.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#514.src: Keep looking then. Return here once you've made a decision.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.dst: O zaman aramaya devam et. Bir karar verdiğinde buraya dön.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#517.src: You children of the {p} gather round
Celebrations in Smoke#517.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#518.src: To gaze upon this relic from years past,
Celebrations in Smoke#518.dst: Geçmiş yıllardan kalan bu emanete bakın,
Celebrations in Smoke#518.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#519.src: This effigy, of ancient foes we fought—
Celebrations in Smoke#519.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#520.src: In memory, we will again ignite!
Celebrations in Smoke#520.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#521.src: An ancient beast, rebuilt with plank and straw,
Celebrations in Smoke#521.dst: Tahta ve samanla yeniden kurulmuş kadim bir canavar,
Celebrations in Smoke#521.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#522.src: What once was flesh, reconstitute as wood;
Celebrations in Smoke#522.dst: Bir zamanlar et olan, şimdi tahtadan;
Celebrations in Smoke#522.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#523.src: All monsters, old and new, must meet their end—
Celebrations in Smoke#523.dst: Eski yeni bütün canavarlar sonunu bulmalı—
Celebrations in Smoke#523.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#524.src: All fiends must burn! Must broil and char and melt!
Celebrations in Smoke#524.dst: Bütün şeytanlar yanmalı! Kavrulmalı, kömürleşmeli, erimeli!
Celebrations in Smoke#524.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#525.src: Substance beside, all that remains persists...
Celebrations in Smoke#525.dst: Özü gidince geriye kalan tek şey...
Celebrations in Smoke#525.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#526.src: ...as blackened corpse, no threat there can exist!
Celebrations in Smoke#526.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#527.src: Oh, hi, I never got the chance to thank you.
Celebrations in Smoke#527.dst: Ah, selam, sana teşekkür etme fırsatım olmamıştı.
Celebrations in Smoke#527.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#528.src: I'm not sure what happened after you left.
Celebrations in Smoke#528.dst: Sen gittikten sonra ne oldu, emin değilim.
Celebrations in Smoke#528.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#529.src: The festival organizer came back and took Burick/Cerisa away with him.
Celebrations in Smoke#529.dst: Festival düzenleyicisi geri gelip Burick/Cerisa denen kişiyi yanında götürdü.
Celebrations in Smoke#529.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#530.src: I'm not sure what happened but, um, I don't think it was good.
Celebrations in Smoke#530.dst: Ne oldu emin değilim ama, şey, iyi bir şey olduğunu sanmıyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#530.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#531.src: So, thank you again. I wasn't really in the right mind enough to show it then.
Celebrations in Smoke#531.dst: Yani, tekrar teşekkürler. O zaman bunu gösterecek kadar kendimde değildim.
Celebrations in Smoke#531.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#533.src: I'll see how long I can hang around here, but the locals are beginning to glare at me a bit.
Celebrations in Smoke#533.dst: Burada ne kadar takılabileceğime bakacağım ama yerliler bana biraz ters ters bakmaya başladı.
Celebrations in Smoke#533.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#534.src: I might try to head deeper into the woods, see if there's anything I can find.
Celebrations in Smoke#534.dst: Belki ormanın daha derinlerine gitmeyi denerim, bir şey bulabilir miyim diye bakarım.
Celebrations in Smoke#534.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#535.src: Or join the military? I don't think I'd be very good at it and I don't even think they'd accept me, but it might be worth a shot.
Celebrations in Smoke#535.dst: Ya da orduya katılsam mı? Pek iyi olacağımı sanmıyorum, beni kabul edeceklerini bile sanmıyorum ama denemeye değebilir.
Celebrations in Smoke#535.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#536.src: Otherwise, all I can do is try to live off of what I can find. I, uh, don't like my chances with that.
Celebrations in Smoke#536.dst: Yoksa tek yapabileceğim bulduklarımla geçinmeye çalışmak. Bu konuda, ıı, şansıma pek güvenmiyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#536.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#537.src: I am! I'm always a, uh, little nervous. But a lot less than I was.
Celebrations in Smoke#537.dst: İyiyim! Her zaman, ıı, biraz gerginimdir. Ama eskisinden çok daha az.
Celebrations in Smoke#537.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#538.src: It felt like the axe that had been pressed against my neck was lifted, thanks to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#538.dst: Senin sayende boynuma dayanmış balta kalkmış gibi hissettim.
Celebrations in Smoke#538.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#539.src: There's still a lot of uncertainty, but I no longer feel like I'm scrambling like a rabbit in a cage.
Celebrations in Smoke#539.dst: Hâlâ çok belirsizlik var ama artık kafesteki bir tavşan gibi çırpındığımı hissetmiyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#539.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#540.src: I was still in a bit of a daze, so not really, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#540.dst: Hâlâ biraz sersemdim, o yüzden pek değil, özür dilerim.
Celebrations in Smoke#540.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#541.src: She left pretty quick though, she must have been in a hurry to get somewhere
Celebrations in Smoke#541.dst: Ama çok çabuk ayrıldı, bir yere yetişmek için acelesi vardı herhalde
Celebrations in Smoke#541.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#543.src: Hello. Please try not to come too close.
Celebrations in Smoke#543.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#544.src: We can talk from a distance.
Celebrations in Smoke#544.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#545.src: Apologies for the coolness, your help was appreciated.
Celebrations in Smoke#545.dst: Soğukluğum için kusura bakma, yardımın için minnettarım.
Celebrations in Smoke#545.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#546.src: But I cannot be sure you are who you say you are.
Celebrations in Smoke#546.dst: Ama dediğin kişi olduğundan emin olamam.
Celebrations in Smoke#546.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#548.src: Since our run in at the festival, I have been laying lower than usual.
Celebrations in Smoke#548.dst: Festivaldeki o karşılaşmamızdan beri her zamankinden daha çok göze batmamaya çalışıyorum.
Celebrations in Smoke#548.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#549.src: My life has not been much different than it usually is.
Celebrations in Smoke#549.dst: Hayatım her zamankinden pek farklı değil.
Celebrations in Smoke#549.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#550.src: It was a horrific mistake to even attend the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#550.dst: Festivale gitmek bile korkunç bir hataydı.
Celebrations in Smoke#550.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#551.src: I allowed myself to be controlled by my own humanity; that is a mistake the {p} rarely lets off easily.
Celebrations in Smoke#551.dst: Kendi insanlığımın beni yönetmesine izin verdim; {p} böyle bir hatayı nadiren kolay affeder.
Celebrations in Smoke#551.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#552.src: I will not make the same mistake again. Loneliness will hurt, but trust will kill.
Celebrations in Smoke#552.dst: Aynı hatayı bir daha yapmayacağım. Yalnızlık acıtır ama güven öldürür.
Celebrations in Smoke#552.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#553.src: Last I saw, they were still in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#553.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#554.src: They don't seem cut out for the life of a scavenger, if they can't find any other way to live outside a clan they'll be dead within the week.
Celebrations in Smoke#554.dst: Çöpçü hayatına uygun biri gibi görünmüyor; bir klanın dışında yaşamanın başka bir yolunu bulamazsa bir hafta içinde ölür.
Celebrations in Smoke#554.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#556.src: Yes, while everyone else was watching the wickerman burn she rustled through as many abandoned stalls, bags, and houses as she could.
Celebrations in Smoke#556.dst: Evet, herkes hasır adamın yanışını izlerken o, terk edilmiş tezgâhları, çantaları ve evleri elinden geldiğince karıştırdı.
Celebrations in Smoke#556.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#557.src: I left before she was finished, but this morning I saw a figure walking south out of {p}, carrying several large bags.
Celebrations in Smoke#557.dst: O işini bitirmeden ayrıldım ama bu sabah {p} şehrinden güneye doğru yürüyen, birkaç büyük çanta taşıyan birini gördüm.
Celebrations in Smoke#557.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#558.src: Wherever she's headed, she's prepared for a long trek.
Celebrations in Smoke#558.dst: Nereye gidiyorsa uzun bir yolculuğa hazırlanmış.
Celebrations in Smoke#558.speaker: Burick
